import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

assets = ['000300.SH','000688.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px = {}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date')
    px[a] = df.set_index('date')['close']
px = pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index()
print("px shape:", px.shape, px.index.min(), px.index.max())

# window end = visible through 2035-11-07
end = px.index.max()
print("last date:", end)

def rets(df, n):
    return df.iloc[-1]/df.iloc[-1-n] - 1 if len(df) > n else np.nan

def ma_pos(df, n):
    ma = df.rolling(n).mean().iloc[-1]
    return df.iloc[-1]/ma - 1

def r2_trend(df, n):
    y = df.iloc[-n:]
    x = np.arange(len(y))
    if y.std() == 0: return np.nan
    return np.corrcoef(x, y)[0,1]**2 * np.sign(np.polyfit(x, y, 1)[0])

def ann_vol(df, n):
    r = df.pct_change().iloc[-n:]
    return r.std()*np.sqrt(252)

rows = {}
for a in assets:
    s = px[a].dropna()
    r10, r20, r60 = rets(s,10), rets(s,20), rets(s,60)
    rows[a] = dict(
        last=s.iloc[-1], r10=r10, r20=r20, r60=r60,
        ma20=ma_pos(s,20), ma60=ma_pos(s,60),
        r2_30=r2_trend(s,30), vol20=ann_vol(s,20), vol60=ann_vol(s,60)
    )
res = pd.DataFrame(rows).T
pd.set_option('display.width', 200)
print(res.round(4).to_string())
print("\nCross-sectional dispersion (10d abs mean dev):", (res['r10']-res['r10'].mean()).abs().mean().round(4))
print("Cross-sectional dispersion (20d):", (res['r20']-res['r20'].mean()).abs().mean().round(4))
print("Breadth r10>0:", (res['r10']>0).sum(), "/", len(res))
print("Breadth r20>0:", (res['r20']>0).sum(), "/", len(res))
print("Breadth r60>0:", (res['r60']>0).sum(), "/", len(res))
print("\nMean r10:", res['r10'].mean().round(4), "Mean r20:", res['r20'].mean().round(4), "Mean r60:", res['r60'].mean().round(4))
print("Median vol20:", res['vol20'].median().round(4))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
def load(p):
    df = pd.read_csv(p)
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')
    return df[df.index <= '2035-11-07']

# Macro observables (observation-only)
for name, path in [('DXY','../persistent/index_data/DXY.csv'),
                   ('USDCNY','../persistent/index_data/USDCNY.csv'),
                   ('USDJPY','../persistent/index_data/USDJPY.csv'),
                   ('EURUSD','../persistent/index_data/EURUSD.csv'),
                   ('VIX','../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv')]:
    df = load(path)
    if 'close' not in df.columns and 'Close' in df.columns: df = df.rename(columns={'Close':'close'})
    if df['close'].isna().all(): df['close'] = df.iloc[:,0]
    s = df['close'].dropna()
    last = s.iloc[-1]
    r10 = last/s.iloc[-11]-1 if len(s)>11 else np.nan
    r20 = last/s.iloc[-21]-1 if len(s)>21 else np.nan
    r60 = last/s.iloc[-61]-1 if len(s)>61 else np.nan
    ma20 = last/s.rolling(20).mean().iloc[-1]-1 if len(s)>20 else np.nan
    ma60 = last/s.rolling(60).mean().iloc[-1]-1 if len(s)>60 else np.nan
    # VIX shown as level not return
    print(f"{name:8s} last={last:9.3f} chg10d={r10*100:7.2f}% chg20d={r20*100:7.2f}% chg60d={r60*100:7.2f}% vsMA20={ma20*100:7.2f}% vsMA60={ma60*100:7.2f}%")

# Also get earlier VIX levels for context
vi = load('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv')
vi = vi.rename(columns={vi.columns[0]:'close'}) if 'close' not in vi.columns else vi
v = vi['close'].dropna()
print("\nVIX recent:", [round(x,2) for x in v.iloc[-5:]])
print("VIX 60d ago:", round(v.iloc[-61],2), "| 120d ago:", round(v.iloc[-121],2) if len(v)>121 else 'NA')
EOF

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
close={}
for s in ['SPX','NDX','SOX','WTI','XAU','COPPER','BTC','ETH','N225','SX5E']:
    df=pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{s}.csv')
    df.columns=[c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    datecol=[c for c in df.columns if 'date' in c.lower()][0]
    df=df[df[datecol].astype(str)<=str('2035-12-05')].tail(65)
    close[s]=df['close'].astype(float).values
# compute vol and trend stats
def ann_vol(x):
    r=np.diff(x)/x[:-1]
    return np.std(r)*np.sqrt(252)*100
for s in close:
    x=close[s]
    vol=ann_vol(x[-21:])
    r20=(x[-1]/x[-21]-1)*100
    r60=(x[-1]/x[-61]-1)*100 if len(x)>=61 else float('nan')
    print(f'{s:<8} vol20={vol:5.1f}% 20d={r20:+6.2f}% 60d={r60:+6.2f}%')
"
